title: Georgia O'keefe museum and home

services.name: Audio Guide
services.desc: The Georgia O’Keeffe Museum offers a variety of in-person tours to all K-12 students to engage students and connect to classroom practice. The Georgia O’Keeffe Museum is proud to offer in-class visits by request for Santa Fe students in grades kindergarten through 12th grade. The Santa Fe Community Educators Network recognizes the importance of providing interactive educational opportunities for students in and out of the classroom. This page contains distance learning tools and materials organized according to grade level and subject type. The Museum offers discounted admission to New Mexico K-12 educators year round. Advance reservations recommended. Contact Visitor Services today! Please

services.desc: Explore the local and seasonal plant life of Abiquiú to create unique watercolor paints! Make your own watercolor paints with cultivated and foraged plants from the surrounding landscape. In this class, enjoy a sensory exploration of place, plant knowledge, and sustainable creativity, beginning with an inspiring walk through Georgia O’Keeffe’s own historical garden. Throughout the workshop, participants will learn the complete process of making watercolor paint from plants-from identifying and ethically harvesting wild dye plants, to extracting color, to binding pigment into rich, archival-quality paints. You’ll leave with a deeper understanding of the ecological and chemical principles

services.name: Class
services.desc: Study and play in this workshop exploring the beauty of expansive skies and expressive clouds in gouache. Inspired by Georgia O’Keeffe’s early expressive watercolor paintings, we’ll explore blending techniques, layering for depth, and experimenting with color to create luminous, dynamic skyscapes. Through guided exercises, this class encourages both mastery and play, helping you push the boundaries of gouache while capturing the ever-changing skies above. Perfect for artists of all levels looking to expand their technical skills in gouache and embrace creative experimentation. This class is suitable for youth ages 12 and up.
